sources.title: Pathumma LLM: AI Technology Tailored to Thai Context and Culture
sources.snippet: Pathumma LLM is an advanced AI technology designed to understand Thai linguistic and cultural contexts. Developed by Dr. Sarawut Khongyang and his team at the National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (NECTEC), under NSTDA, this innovation marks a significant milestone in Thailand's AI development.
